title: Feed-outage rescue on Base Sepolia, Mon 12 Oct 2026 (the Saturday rescue's two actions under a staged frozen feed)
why: Why in session: the 9-11 Oct weekend passed without the two recorded rescues (docs/evidence/saturday-rescue-2026-10-10.md). The ShadowGuard treats FEED_STALE exactly like MARKET_CLOSED (`heldFeed` in ShadowGuard.shadowPrice), so a feed that stops printing in an open session takes the same protection path as a weekend: the venue oracle (SessionGuard) refuses to price, the shadow price is the pool TWAP less 200 bps, the keeper may close out on the Protector and repay down the vault's ladder, each armed as a validity transaction on the feed's updatedAt slot. The staging is the 8 Oct stale-feed drill's: the keeper's mirror of AAPLt is held (KV), and the AAPLt test feed is rewritten to the same round and answer with an updatedAt 27 h old (heartbeat 24 h + tolerance 2 h). Nothing here claims a weekend.
